what_this_is: How far one decision has got, as named steps each kept as a fact on the decision (src/work-progress.mjs progressFromSteps, sent with each decision on the Decisions screen and read by AIs). A step counts only when its fact is true: decided is a recorded choice, carried_out is the receipt that its next action was done (say_what_was_done, src/decision-store.mjs carriedOut), result_checked is a settled result (src/check-uses.mjs decisionResult). A new step is one row here and one fact on the summary.
